description: Hi! I am from Pakistan. I love space and storytelling. I chose the challenge "Abandoned but not Forgotten" because I want to tell the emotional story of forgotten things in space. I can write and make creative ideas.
summary: Our project, Abandoned but Not Forgotten, tells the emotional story of NASA's equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars. Through a short storytelling video, Team Cosmic Dreamers gives a voice to the forgotten heroes like rovers, landers, and orbiters that completed their missions but never came home.We show how these machines helped us learn about space, water, and other planets, and why their stories still matter. Our project uses simple storytelling, visuals, and narration to make space history easy and interesting for everyone, especially for students.Our message is simple: these heroes are abandoned, but not forgotten.
details: Our project is called "Abandoned but Not Forgotten". It is a short video story about NASA's rovers, landers and machines that were left on the Moon and Mars after their missions ended.Our video shows how these machines worked, what they discovered like water, rocks and weather, and why they are still important today even though they are silent now.The benefit of our project is to teach students and children that these heroes should not be forgotten. It creates love for space, science and NASA missions.We used Google and NASA's official website for images and information, and CapCut for video editing and narration. Our story, script and voiceover is our own original work. Our project is creative because we tell the story from the machines' point of view, as if they are speaking to us.
